gloss: real · solid · full — fruit, substance, reality
formNote: The Shuowen: 實，富也。从宀从貫。貫，貨貝也 — “wealth: a roof over strings of cowrie money.” Mojidata IDS gives ⿱宀貫. Solid, full, real: what is actually there.
summary: Full, solid, real: fruit as against flower, the full as against the empty, actuality as against its name. In 如實 it renders bhūta, “what has come to be”: the real is what has actually happened.
placement: At the fixed point x = y = z ≈ 2.576 on the system’s axis of symmetry (where sin x = 0.208 x; there is a third at ≈ −2.576), the one this attractor winds around, opposite 如 at the origin. (Placement is a design choice, not a claim.)

oc.note: † Baracus, from general knowledge; not yet checked against B–S 2014.

satellites.title: Strings of Cowries Under a Roof
satellites.evidence: The Shuowen: 實，富也。从宀从貫。貫，貨貝也 — “wealth: from roof, and from 貫, strung cowrie money.” Before it meant “real”, 實 meant a house that was full.
satellites.caveat: The Shuowen’s analysis of the seal form; the earliest forms should be checked against the bronze corpus.
